services.name: Jet Ski rental

We rent by the half hour and the full hour, so you have plenty of time to enjoy the beautiful waters in our large riding area. Long Beach Island is a mere 18 miles long- Route 72 is an easy jet ski rental company to locate from the southern or northern tip of LBI. Ride your jet ski over the waves while passing sandy beaches, pristine nature, or wide-open bay.
